changeset.goal: Restore observed tag update convergence for existing MetricAlarm resources by making the update path apply declared tag additions, value changes, and removals externally, while preserving tags when unchanged.

preserve_constraints.statement: When the desired tags remain unchanged, the update path must preserve the existing external tag set.
preserve_constraints.coverage_rationale: Current update path sends tags only in PutMetricAlarmInput, which the supplied field contract says is ignored for existing alarms; unchanged desired tags therefore do not trigger an external tag mutation, preserving the existing tag set. External tag state is not publicly observable.
semantic_statements: If desired tags equal latest tags, no effective tag mutation is sent.

open_obligations.statement: When a MetricAlarm declaration changes the tags of an existing managed alarm, its update path must make the externally stored tag keys and values match the declaration.
open_obligations.reason: Requires evidence of the SDK tag mutation client bindings and current-tag retrieval before an executable production change can be planned.
semantic_statements: Declared tag changes must converge externally.

open_obligations.statement: Tag additions, value changes, and removals on an existing managed alarm must take effect externally.
open_obligations.reason: Requires evidence of the SDK tag mutation client bindings and current-tag retrieval before an executable production change can be planned.
semantic_statements: Additions, value changes, and removals must all be applied.

precondition_review.condition: The supplied Tags field contract states that PutMetricAlarm ignores supplied tags for an existing alarm and directs tag changes to TagResource/UntagResource.
precondition_review.rationale: This source is the basis for the violation but does not evidence the SDK client methods or how current tags are read; those missing contracts are tracked in open obligations.

preservation_impact.rationale: No executable changes proposed this round; any future tag reconciliation must avoid mutations when desired tags are unchanged.

production_path_review.rationale: newUpdateRequestPayload currently copies Spec.Tags into PutMetricAlarmInput.Tags, but the supplied contract says those tags are ignored for an existing alarm; the repair strategy depends on missing SDK tag-operation bindings and current-tag retrieval, so this branch is unresolved.
newCreateRequestPayload builds the create request; the obligation trigger is an existing managed alarm update, so this create-path branch is not the update-path consumer under repair.
